# QuantCore-Labs

> Free, client-side quantitative finance micro-tools and a glossary of quant terms. Each tool is a single static page that computes in the browser; no sign-up, no data upload.

All tools document their formulas, units and conventions on-page. Glossary entries give a definition, formula, institutional usage and a tested Python reference implementation.

## Tools

- [Black-Scholes Option Greeks Calculator](https://quantcore-labs.com/option-greeks-calc/): European call/put price, Delta, Gamma, Vega (per vol pt), Theta (per day), Rho (per 1%) under Black-Scholes-Merton with continuous dividend yield. Markdown: https://quantcore-labs.com/option-greeks-calc.md
- [Monte Carlo Asset Path Simulator](https://quantcore-labs.com/tools/monte-carlo-asset-sim/): Geometric Brownian Motion path simulation with multi-trajectory chart and confidence-interval statistics.
- [Markowitz Efficient Frontier Calculator](https://quantcore-labs.com/tools/portfolio-efficient-frontier/): Mean-variance optimisation, maximum-Sharpe portfolio weights and efficient frontier from expected returns and a covariance matrix.
- [Performance & Drawdown Analytics Calculator](https://quantcore-labs.com/tools/performance-analytics/): Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, CAGR, max drawdown and duration, VaR/CVaR and monthly returns from a pasted equity curve, returns or PnL; 252/242/365 annualisation. Markdown: https://quantcore-labs.com/performance-analytics.md
- [Implied Volatility Smile & Skew Calculator](https://quantcore-labs.com/tools/iv-smile/): back out IV across strikes and expiries (Black-76, safeguarded Newton), infer the forward from put-call parity, fit ATM IV/skew/curvature, plot smiles and ATM term structure. Markdown: https://quantcore-labs.com/iv-smile.md

## Glossary

- [Glossary index](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/): all terms
- [Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP)](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/vwap/): The ratio of cumulative traded value to cumulative volume over a horizon. The standard benchmark for judging institutional execution quality.
- [Order Flow Imbalance (OFI)](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/ofi/): Net buy-minus-sell pressure at the best bid and ask, measured from changes in top-of-book prices and sizes. Short-horizon price changes are approximately linear in OFI.
- [Hurst Exponent (H)](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/hurst-exponent/): A scaling exponent that measures long-range dependence in a time series. H < 0.5 indicates mean reversion, H = 0.5 a random walk, and H > 0.5 a persistent, trending series.
- [Information Coefficient (IC)](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/information-coefficient/): The cross-sectional correlation between a factor's values and subsequent asset returns. Rank IC, its mean and ICIR are the standard first test of whether an alpha factor predicts returns.
- [Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) Test](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/adf-test/): A unit-root test that checks whether a time series is non-stationary. In stat-arb it is the standard check that a spread mean-reverts before it is traded.
- [Cointegration (Engle-Granger & Johansen)](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/cointegration/): Two or more non-stationary price series are cointegrated when some linear combination of them is stationary. This is the statistical basis of pairs and basket trading.
- [Value at Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES)](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/var-expected-shortfall/): VaR is the loss threshold that is exceeded only with a given small probability. Expected Shortfall is the average loss in that tail. Both are standard risk limits; ES is what Basel FRTB uses for market risk capital.
- [Amihud Illiquidity Measure (ILLIQ)](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/amihud-illiquidity/): The average absolute return per unit of traded value: how much the price moves for each yuan or dollar traded. It is a low-frequency price-impact proxy and a widely used liquidity factor.

## Code

- [Code snippets index](https://quantcore-labs.com/code/): tested Python implementations, MIT licensed
- [rolling-window-numba.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/code/rolling-window-numba/rolling-window-numba.py): Numba Rolling Operators (numpy, numba)
- [duckdb-parquet-ticks.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/code/duckdb-parquet-ticks/duckdb-parquet-ticks.py): DuckDB + Parquet Ticks (duckdb)
- [vectorized-backtest.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/code/vectorized-backtest/vectorized-backtest.py): Vectorised Backtest (numpy, pandas, polars)
- [vwap.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/vwap/vwap.py): VWAP in Python (numpy, pandas)
- [ofi.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/ofi/ofi.py): OFI in Python (numpy, pandas)
- [hurst-exponent.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/hurst-exponent/hurst-exponent.py): Hurst Exponent in Python (numpy)
- [information-coefficient.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/information-coefficient/information-coefficient.py): Information Coefficient in Python (numpy, pandas)
- [adf-test.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/adf-test/adf-test.py): ADF Test in Python (numpy, statsmodels)
- [cointegration.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/cointegration/cointegration.py): Cointegration in Python (numpy, statsmodels)
- [var-expected-shortfall.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/var-expected-shortfall/var-expected-shortfall.py): VaR & ES in Python (numpy, scipy)
- [amihud-illiquidity.py](https://quantcore-labs.com/glossary/amihud-illiquidity/amihud-illiquidity.py): Amihud Illiquidity in Python (numpy, pandas)
